## Summary

Describe the requested feature or improvement.

## Motivation

Explain the problem, limitation, or need that this request addresses.

## Proposed solution

Describe the expected behavior or implementation at a high level.

## Scope

Describe what should be included in this issue.

## Additional context

Add examples, references, technical considerations, or related issues.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The proposed behavior has been implemented.
- [ ] Relevant tests have been added or updated.
- [ ] Existing tests pass without regressions.
- [ ] Documentation has been updated when necessary.
